summary: 3D Systems filed an 8-K disclosing privately negotiated exchange agreements with all holders of its 5.875% convertible senior secured notes due 2030. It will exchange $92.03M principal for $20M cash plus accrued interest, 13,471,138 common shares, and $85M of new 3.30% convertible senior unsecured notes due 2031, converting at ~$3.43/share, a ~30% premium to the $2.64 NYSE close on November 4, 2026. No advisor or board recommendation disclosed. Closing is targeted around December 2026; watch deleveraging, dilution and noteholder conversion overhang.
